_comment: Perpl on Monad mainnet. Addresses from docs.perpl.xyz and the Agora docs (read in Chrome 2026-10-11), re-checked on chain: the exchange has code, getContractVersion() = 1.7.5, getExchangeInfo() names AUSD as the collateral token (6 decimals). Decimals and the minimum deposit below are what was read on 2026-10-11; code must read them live (getPerpetualInfoV2, getMinAccountOpenCNS) and never rely on these copies.

ausd._storage: AUSD is an upgradeable proxy. Found by tracing balanceOf/allowance with debug_traceCall (prestateTracer) and matching the implementation's PUSH32 constants: balanceOf(a) is stored at keccak256(abi.encode(a, balanceBase)) as (amount << 8) because the low byte holds flags; allowance(o, s) is stored at keccak256(abi.encode(s, keccak256(abi.encode(o, balanceBase + 1)))) as the plain amount. Only used to fake balances in eth_call simulations.

scan._comment: Same public RPC limit as Kuru: eth_getLogs over at most about 100 blocks per request (probed 2026-10-10).
